wavefront_product_on_U.argument: XVI-J prop:q / lem:WF: at a nonzero null point, Q is a submersion and (Q-i0)^{-1} has a single conormal orientation, so WF covectors cannot cancel pairwise. The same one-ray bound pulls back to (Q-i0)^{-n} for n>=2 and to polynomials in z times those boundary values. Smooth away from the cone. Hence the finite combinations defining T exist on all of U.
